> **See where your gold is going and coming from!**

## Overview

**MyAccountant** is a World of Warcraft Addon that helps track where your money is going with powerful customization options.

Heavily inspired by AccountantClassic, see a detailed breakdown by source or zone across any timeframe you choose. Whether you're farming gold, managing your auction house empire, or simply curious about your spending habits, see exactly where your money is moving!

**MyAccountant** currently supports all versions of WoW.

![My Accountant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/header1.png)

## Features

### **See your gold per hour**

Track your gold per hour on the configurable minimap icon.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/goldPerHourMinimap.png)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/minimapIconSettings.png)

The minimap tooltip can show summary data from as many of your views as you like and allow you to pick exactly what appears on hover in the minimap tooltip settings.

### **See your income**

The configurable income panel allows you to see where your money is coming and going from, showing you a session or historic breakdown.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeFrameGeneralConfig.png)

**See it by source**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeWindow1.png)

**Or by zone**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeWindow2.png)

Mouse over an income or outcome to see a breakdown. Configurable in options.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/zoneBreakdown.png)

### **Calendar integration**

For days with data, MyAccountant will add icons to the Calendar (if your WoW version has one). See at a glance if you've made or lost money. Highlight over it for more info.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/calendar.png)

Visualize your data easily. Left click on a day to see it in the income panel or right click to add multiple days and shift + right click to see a report.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/calendarReport.png)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/calendarReportFrame.png)

Also available through the `/mya report` commands.

### **Configure your views**

MyAccountant is built around **views** - data sets like your current session, realm balance, or any date range you define. Each view can be surfaced in several places independently: as a tab on the income panel, an entry in the minimap tooltip, an entry on the information frame, or as LibDataBroker data. Manage all of this from the **Views** options page.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/viewsSettings.png)

After enabling views as tabs you can configure their order and where they linebreak in the Tabs subsection in Income panel options.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomePanelConfig.png)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeFrameTabRows.png)

Advanced mode allows you to create your own views and configure them with lua snippets, specifying the exact date range you want to see.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomePanelConfigAdvanced.png)

See the [Custom Tab API Documentation](https://github.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/blob/main/API/CustomTabs.md) for more information.

### **See all your characters**

Track your income as a whole or by each of your characters.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeFrameAllCharacters.png)

Configure which characters to track in the Characters options tab. Choose from presets like all characters, current realm, current faction, or build a custom selection. You can also delete characters you no longer need from the database.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/optionsCharacters.png)

### **See what you want on the information frame**

MyAccountant can display a small information frame containing income data. Configure it in Addon options to show what you want to see.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/infoFrame.png)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/infoFrameConfig.png)

### **See your balance**

MyAccountant tracks your gold balance across your Warband and all your characters on your realm and offers several ways to show that information. You can turn off unwanted display methods in Addon options.

By default the balance covers your current realm. To see every character on your account instead (across all realms and both factions) set **Which characters to show for realm balance** to **All characters on account (all realms)** in the Characters options tab. Characters from other realms are shown with their realm name.

#### Faction icon

Hover over the faction icon to see your total balance.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomeFrameRealmBalance.png)

#### Balance tab

Use the balance tab on the income panel. You can disable this in tab configuration.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/balanceFrame.png)

#### Information panel

You can also configure the information panel to show your balance.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/infoFrameRealmBalance.png)

### **LibDataBroker support**

MyAccountant registers data from your views with **LDB (Lib Data Broker)**. For each view you can pick exactly which values are exposed, using individual checkboxes in the Views options page.

This lets you see MyAccountant information in any addon that supports showing LDB data like Titan Panel or Bazooka.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/titanPanelRealmBalance.png)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/titanPanelWeekProfit.png)

### **Sort by what you want**

Configure the income panel to either sort when opening, or click on a table header to sort either by descending or ascending.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/sorting.png)

### **Configure your week**

Set which day of the week your weekly data starts from in the General settings tab.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/optionWeekStart.png)

### **Supports all WoW versions**

MyAccountant knows which sources are unavailable in each version of WoW. This lets this addon work on Mists Classic, Vanilla, TBC, or Retail.

### **Configure your income sources**

Decide which income sources you want to track by disabling ones you aren't interested in

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/main/Docs/incomesources.png)

## How to install

### Curseforge (Recommended)

1. Search for "MyAccountant" in the CurseForge App
2. Click Install

### Manual

1. Download the [latest release](https://github.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/releases/latest) from the releases page.
2. Extract the zip file into your `Interface/Addons` folder (eg. `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/Addons/`)

## Supported languages

- **English**
- **Russian** (by ZamestoTV)
- **Simplified Chinese** (by cclolz)
- **German** (by LaDzi)
- **Mexican Spanish** (by DarkChiken)

## How to contribute

### Want to add a translation?

Make a copy of [Locales/TEMPLATE.lua](https://github.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/blob/main/Locales/TEMPLATE.lua) and make the necessary changes for your translation.

Then either open up a PR with your change, or create an issue if you're unsure how to complete a merge (and we can do it for you!)

### Want a new feature?

Have an idea for a new feature? [Create an issue](https://github.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/issues/new) describing what you would like to see!

Or, if you're feeling brave you can make the change yourself and submit a pull request! Increasing versions in the toc is not necessary, it's done automatically as part of the release Github Action.

### Find a bug?

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jeany55/MyAccountant/issues/new) on the issues page!

releases.notes:
### New Features
* **LibDataBroker launcher without the minimap icon**: The main MyAccountant launcher is now always available to LibDataBroker displays (Titan Panel, ChocolateBar, Bazooka, etc.), even when the minimap icon is turned off. Previously hiding the minimap icon also removed the launcher from your display bar.

### Bugfixes
* The income panel could be covered by bags and other windows. It now sits above regular windows and comes to the front when clicked.
* The income panel title floated at the top of the screen instead of sitting in the panel's title bar _(Forever only)_.

### Other
* If you had the minimap icon turned off, the MyAccountant launcher may now appear in your LibDataBroker display. Hide it there if you don't want it.

# New features
* In the character options there is now an option to see your total account's balance
* Added Mexican Spanish localization

# Fixes
* Fixed TBC being undetected

* Added support for WoW Forever
* Added user profiles - see the new addition in addon options
